# The Sharp Firm

> Austin-based personal injury law firm specializing in accident cases, medical malpractice, and wrongful death with 30+ years of trial experience.

The Sharp Firm is led by Laura Sharp and Lance Sharp, experienced Austin attorneys offering free consultations for personal injury victims. The firm handles a wide range of cases from vehicle accidents to complex medical malpractice claims across the Greater Austin area.
